description.sub_ename: SUSTAINABLE ENVIRONMENT AND NET ZERO CARBON EMISSIONS
description.describe_ch: 本課程設計的主要目標，是在呈現並清楚的了解目前自然資源的議題與環境政策的考量，其中最重要的是要符合未來淨零碳排的目標。人類經濟活動與自然資源有非常密切的關係，自然環境提供人類經濟活動所需的各種資源和原料，人類利用勞力、技術以及生產設備將這些資源和原料製成消費品提供生活使用，當經濟成長與生態保育、環境保護無法兼容並蓄時，如何以環境經濟理論來解決人類所面臨最棘手的問題，是本課程規劃的宗旨，期在系統性的研討分析中，以宏觀的角度，重新詮釋環境保護活動可以推動經濟成長，經濟成長共可以支持生態保育，並以先進國家為例，說明達成淨零碳排的永續環境發展方向。
description.describe_eh: The main object of this course is to present and clearly understand current natural resource issues and environmental policy considerations, most importantly in line with future net-zero carbon emissions goals. Human economic activities have a very close relationship with natural resources. The natural environment provides various resources and raw materials needed for human economic activities. Humans use labor, technology and production equipment to make these resources and raw materials into consumer goods for daily use. When ecological conservation and environmental protection are incompatible, how to solve the most difficult problems faced by human beings with environmental economic theory is the purpose of this course planning. It is expected to reinterpret environmental protection activities from a macro perspective in a systematic discussion and analysis. It can promote economic growth, and economic growth can support ecological conservation, and take advanced countries as examples to illustrate the direction of sustainable environmental development to achieve net zero carbon emissions.
